labs.title: Lab 1: Getting Started
labs.description: Set up Bob, scan your workspace, initialize Agent.md, generate a Data Dictionary, and derive coding standards.

labs.title: Lab 2: Convert COBOL+DB2 to Java
labs.description: Use IBM Bob to automatically analyze, translate, and modernize COBOL programs and DB2 stored procedures to efficient, maintainable Java code.

labs.title: Lab 3: Convert Progeni to Standard COBOL
labs.description: Modernize reporting and screen assets by converting Progeni Report writer programs to standard COBOL and converting CICS Maps to SDF2 compatible format.

labs.title: Lab 4: Broadcom Exit & Migration Wave Planning
labs.description: Identify obsolete modules and dependencies, group COBOL programs and ADSO screens by business function, and organize in logical migration waves.

labs.title: Lab 5: CPU Optimization
labs.description: Use IBM Bob to analyze code, SQL, and DB2 access patterns to identify bottlenecks and recommend optimizations to reduce CPU consumption and improve system performance.

labs.title: Lab 6: COBOL Code & Data Analysis
labs.description: Perform in-depth analysis of COBOL code and associated data structures to understand impact, dependencies, data flows, and business logic.
